content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess both of the following qualifications: Passed the Maharashtra State Secondary School Certificate examination. Passed ITI in the Electrician trade from an Industrial Training Institute recognized by the National Council for Vocational Training. The candidate's name on the SSC and ITI mark sheets must match the name recorded on the Aadhaar card.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age will be calculated as of 1 September 2026 .

rows.age_limit: Relaxation of 5 years in the upper-age limit

content_sections.heading: Training Period
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be engaged as Electrician apprentices for a period of one year during 2026-27. The apprenticeship will be governed by the applicable apprenticeship rules and regulations.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The apprentice merit list will be prepared using the combined marks obtained in SSC and ITI examinations. Selection will also be made according to the applicable social reservation rules.

content_sections.heading: Maharashtra Domicile Requirement
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a valid Maharashtra domicile certificate. Applicants claiming category or reservation benefits must also submit the applicable certificates issued by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC passing certificate and mark sheet ITI Electrician mark sheets for all four semesters ITI Electrician passing certificate School leaving certificate Aadhaar card Caste certificate, where applicable Maharashtra domicile certificate Non-Creamy Layer certificate for applicable categories EWS certificate, where applicable SEBC certificate issued by the competent authority, where applicable Online apprenticeship registration printout Completed application form attached to the notification Other applicable supporting documents Required documents must first be scanned clearly and uploaded to the candidate's Apprenticeship India profile.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MSETCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Apprenticeship India portal . Complete apprentice registration using a valid email address and mobile number. Enter the correct personal, educational and category information. Upload clear scanned copies of the required certificates. Search for the MSETCL EHV O&M Division, Amravati establishment. Use Establishment Registration Number E01172700169 . Select the Electrician apprenticeship opportunity. Submit the online application between 18 and 30 September 2026. Take a printout of the completed online registration and application. Complete the application form attached to the official notification. Attach self-attested copies of the required documents. Submit the complete application to the prescribed MSETCL office by 15 October 2026 at 6:00 PM. Applications submitted outside the prescribed online application period will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Address for Submitting the Application
content_sections.text: The application may be sent by post or submitted personally at the office within the prescribed deadline.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only candidates who submit the online application between 18 and 30 September 2026 will be considered. Incomplete or incorrectly filled applications will not be accepted. Applications containing false or incorrect information may be rejected. The candidate's SSC, ITI and Aadhaar names must match. A valid email address and mobile number are required during online registration. Original certificates may be required for verification. MSETCL reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions. The management's decision regarding the recruitment process will be final. Any attempt to influence the recruitment process may lead to disqualification. Submitting only the online application is not sufficient; the required hard copy must also reach the MSETCL office by the deadline.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: MSETCL has announced 25 Electrician apprentice positions in its EHV O&M Division, Amravati.

faq.question: Q2. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC and ITI in the Electrician trade from an NCVT-recognized Industrial Training Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted by 30 September 2026, up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date for submitting the hard copy?
faq.answer: The application printout and supporting documents must reach the prescribed MSETCL office by 15 October 2026, up to 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 38 years as of 1 September 2026. Eligible backward-class candidates receive five years of upper-age relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the training period?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training period is one year.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The merit list will be prepared by giving 50% weightage to SSC marks and 50% weightage to ITI marks, subject to applicable reservation rules.

faq.question: Q8. Is Maharashtra domicile required?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must possess a valid Maharashtra domicile certificate.
